instruments.notes: Forward sales arrangements covering approximately 40% of estimated net gas production in the Lake Enfermer Field; absolute volume not stated; price is approximate weighted average.
instruments.evidence_quote:
In January 1997, the
Company entered into forward sales arrangements with respect to approximately
40% of its estimated net natural gas production in the Lake Enfermer Field
through April 1997, at a weighted average price of approximately $3.18 per Mcf.

instruments.notes: Described only as hedging approximately 30% of estimated net oil production, entered at the same time as the January 1997 gas forwards; instrument form not specified (financial statement note mentions swap agreements generally); absolute volume not stated.
instruments.evidence_quote:
At the same time, the Company hedged approximately 30% of its estimated net oil
production through June 1997 at a weighted average price of $23.75 per Bbl.

instruments.notes: Forward sales arrangements covering approximately 25% of estimated net gas production in the Lake Enfermer Field; absolute volume not stated; price is approximate weighted average.
instruments.evidence_quote:
In October 1997, the Company entered into forward sales arrangements with respect
to approximately 25% of its estimated net natural gas production in the Lake
Enfermer Field through March 1998, at a weighted average price of approximately $3.19 per Mcf.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Hedges to achieve more predictable revenues and cash flows and reduce price exposure; limited portion of production; reevaluated continuously; not used for trading.
